mathematical_contract.cusp_to_parallel: For represented semicircle parameter u, D=(1-u)^2+u^2 and A=1-2u. The inverse constructs the exact radial-dot equality D*diameter_side-A*radius_squared_denominator, squares only for complete projection, reduces it in the retained cusp field, and replays the unsquared radical expression at every candidate.
mathematical_contract.norm_candidates: Hypersolve's quotient-ring norm contains every root on the selected cusp fiber and may also contain roots contributed by conjugate cusp roots. The unsquared replay evaluates each numeric candidate at the selected cusp root; it therefore rejects foreign norm candidates and the opposite radical branch in one exact predicate. A separate selected-fiber membership pass would prove the same fact twice.
mathematical_contract.parallel_to_cusp: A parameter already on the published analytic overlap is stored as a compact shared-map contact. Endpoint parameters reuse the published cusp endpoints; interior parameters preserve the analytic parameter itself and do not construct another selected-root tower.
mathematical_contract.carrier_clipping: The cusp overlap is first intersected in its native monotone domain. Its surviving endpoints are transported to the analytic domain, intersected with the published analytic overlap and carrier range, and any further analytic cuts are transported back through the same map. Returned ranges remain ascending independently of fragment traversal.
mathematical_contract.policy: Every comparison, projection, root isolation, and radical predicate receives CurveContext. STRICT accepts only certified outcomes. APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only at the shared Hyperlimit/Hypersolve 512-bit predicate boundary and records consumption; no binary floating-point geometry is introduced.
